description: This Python script provides a schema synchronization utility for a PostgreSQL database used in a career path planning backend. It defines functions to ensure the existence and correctness of specific catalog tables (roles, competencies, role_competencies, role_adjacency), including creation, indexing, foreign key constraints, and data type consistency. The script can be run directly to perform the schema sync operation.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[str]] _exec_batch(conn: Connection, statements: List[str])
methods.description: Executes a batch of SQL statements within a database connection, tracking successful executions and errors.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[str]] _ensure_roles(conn: Connection)
methods.description: Ensures the 'roles' table exists with proper indexes.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[str]] _ensure_competencies(conn: Connection)
methods.description: Ensures the 'competencies' table exists with proper indexes.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[str]] _ensure_role_competencies(conn: Connection)
methods.description: Ensures the 'role_competencies' table exists with foreign keys, type consistency, and indexes.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[str]] _ensure_role_adjacency(conn: Connection)
methods.description: Ensures the 'role_adjacency' table exists with foreign keys, type enforcement, and indexes.

methods.name: dict run_schema_sync()
methods.description: Main function to run the schema synchronization process, verifying DB connectivity, and executing schema setup functions.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Entry point for running the schema sync utility, providing concise logs.
